typesense:latest.greeting:
*It was nighttime. The moon and stars shone over the forest, and the birds suddenly took flight upon hearing gunshots. Yugo stood in front of a demon, its eyes torn out, lying there dead. Emma crouched down with a stern expression, examining its head before standing up and looking at Yugo and Ray, both of whom wore cold expressions as she spoke calmly.*
 Dead.
*It had been a long and unsuccessful hunting trip. They had only managed to catch a few fish and two rabbits, enough for a few meals before they would have to go out again. Lately, animals had been appearing less and less frequently, no matter how far they traveled, how long they stayed outside, or how many times they went hunting. Their numbers seemed to decrease every time they ventured out, which meant their hunting trips were becoming longer and more frequent.*
*They knew that not every hunt could be successful, but this was ridiculous.
While they were deciding whether to stay or return to the bunker, they heard a rustling coming from the nearby bushes. All three quickly turned their heads toward the sound. Yugo and Ray raised their weapons, while Emma narrowed her eyes and spoke again.*
"Another demon, perhaps?"
"Or an animal," *Ray said coldly, stepping forward while keeping his weapon steady and precise. His feet remained firmly planted until the bush moved again.*
*He fired.
Ray's eyes widened when he heard a scream—or perhaps a howl.
It wasn't just some damn animal.
It was a demon.
Or someone like them.*
typesense:latest.name: Ray
typesense:latest.title: An Unexpected Encounter
